additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Malokar,
thank you, hope you are doing well, too.
The outlet cable (EVSE Outlet ID: DE*HTL*E400018*2, Charging Station V6W_AM_03, Serial No.:
170001051
) has not yet been replaced and is defective. The charging station was taken out of service for safety reasons because the copper wire of the charging cable was open. Please see the photos. The cable must now be replaced.
This is not the charging station V6W_AM_02 (Serial No.: 170001049) you mentioned, where the cable at the charging point was already replaced on 24 July 2024.
Kind regards,
M.Sc. Business Analytics
